strongest_angle: Examining the multi-day search operations and final recovery of missing 24-year-old hiker Sahil Jilani by dive teams at Abrams Falls within the Great Smoky Mountains National Park.

key_facts.fact: Sahil Jilani, a 24-year-old man from Texas, was reported missing after visiting the Great Smoky Mountains National Park and was last seen at Riverstone Campground in Townsend at approximately 8 p.m. on October 5.
Dive teams recovered the body of Sahil Jilani at Abrams Falls on October 8, 2026, following a days-long search operation in Blount County, Tennessee.
Officials at the Great Smoky Mountains National Park and family members confirmed that Sahil Jilani's vehicle was discovered near the popular hiking trail before divers located him in the water.
